test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, 8% of the votes were invalid. The winning candidate got 60% of the total valid votes and won the election by 5888 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
**Given:**

8% of the votes are invalid

Winner got 60% of the valid votes

Winners won by 5888 votes

**Calculation:**

Let the total numbers of voters be 100a

Valid votes = 100a - 100a × 8%

⇒ 92a

Winning candidate got 92a × 60%

⇒ 55.2a

So, loosing candidate got = 92a - 55.2a

⇒ 36.8a

According to the question,

55.2a - 36.8a = 5888

⇒ 18.4a = 5888

⇒ a = 5888/18.4

⇒ a = 320

So, total voters registered = 320 × 100

⇒ 32000

**∴ 32000 voters were registered.**
